text: Level three, question six: pipes A and B together fill a tank in ten hours, B and C in eighteen hours, and C and A in fifteen hours; how long would each pipe take alone? Question seven: pipe A fills a tank in eight minutes and pipe B in twelve minutes; with a third pipe C also open, the tank fills in six minutes; describe pipe C. Question eight: pipe A fills a tank in six hours and pipe B in nine hours, and together they deliver fifty litres a minute; find the capacity of the tank.
